📺 Superstore (2015–2021)

Superstore follows a hilarious group of employees working at Cloud 9, a fictional big-box retail store in St. Louis, Missouri. From dealing with demanding customers and ridiculous store policies to navigating workplace romances, unexpected friendships, and everyday challenges, the employees experience countless unforgettable moments. At the center of the story are Amy Sosa, a hardworking employee trying to balance her career and personal life, and Jonah Simms, an enthusiastic newcomer whose idealistic personality frequently creates awkward situations. Alongside their eccentric coworkers, including Dina, Garrett, Cheyenne, and Mateo, they turn ordinary workdays into chaotic adventures filled with humor and heart. Through clever comedy and relatable storytelling, Superstore explores friendship, teamwork, relationships, workplace struggles, and the unpredictable experiences of retail workers.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Workplace • Sitcom

⭐ IMDb: 7.9/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 22 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Creator: Justin Spitzer

📺 Where to Watch: Peacock and Hulu in the United States. Availability varies by region.
